Lets an item on once enough different traders agreed within a while: at 2 in 6h, a trade goes on when another trader made the same one in the 6 hours before. The others leave from alone. It remembers across runs and restarts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.consensus` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `alone` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| At least (`needed`) | whole number | no | `2` | How many different traders must agree, this item's among them. |
| Within (`within`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `6h` | How far back a trader's agreeing counts, from each item. |
| Agree on (`on`) | list of text | no | `tokenId`, `side` | The fields that must be the same, one per line: the outcome and the side by default, so a buy and a sell do not count together. Each names a field of the items it receives; saving checks the items have it. |
| Who (`who`) | text | no | `trader.address` | The field that tells traders apart: one counts once, however often they trade. Names a field of the items it receives; saving checks the items have it. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
